limitations: The catalog remains open-world: sealing this revision does not assert that no future domain, source revision, counterexample, or adapter can be discovered.
The four-dimensional (x,y,z,w) all-spatial shadow remains observer-only; exact graph reachability and full 48-dimensional coordinates remain authoritative.
World evidence is model-independent; the separately validated Qwen3.8-27B adapter is not embedded in world artifacts.
scope: All 178 worlds registered in the hash-bound catalog at the stated source revision passed every pre-registered training, held-out, negative-control, and four-dimensional shadow gate on a real eight-device Kaggle TPU and were independently hash-validated and loaded by the Rust runtime.
